did: Drafted the open-question video essay on why our merges wait in line on a free GitHub account (#3387), then built what blocked it. The draft's shot list and narration came first, with stills taken from public GitHub pages and charts drawn from the CI audit. Four blockers were then built, each on its own branch, and all four land in bucket 2 (#3403). An essay can now show a public page photographed logged out, as a third kind of screen beside snips and clip frames. It can draw a chart card, bars-v1, in cheat-sheet version 5. A chapter of several cards is said and marked once, at its first scene, under the owner's decision on CE1. And the routine now says cards-check checks the folder, while the render checks the cards. Merged together locally, the whole 16-scene essay renders silent at 5:52. The audit's data went to paulgsc/testing as derived tables, because testing's guard refuses the raw pulls.

calls.title: How a public page is photographed for an essay (C1030)
options: one fixed desktop size, logged out
a size per page, chosen by the essay
a full-page capture instead of the window
calls.why: No check or earlier decision says what size a page of someone else's site is taken at. The snips' desktop size keeps the family alike, and the window matches what a viewer sees on opening the address. A page that doesn't load or lands elsewhere is refused. Its picture's name leaves out the query, so a token in a query can't reach a published name. How the pictures reach home is left open, because testing's guard refuses every picture.
calls.undo: Take the viewport from the capture list per page, or screenshot the whole page, and say so in docs/snips.md.

calls.title: The chart card comes in as cheat-sheet v5, pinned only for an essay with a chart (C1031)
options: routine pins v5 for every essay
routine pins v4, and v5 only for an essay with a chart
edit v4 to add the bars design
calls.why: A published series version is never edited, so the card needs a new version. Moving every essay to it would make each one wait on home's rebuilt render image, as C841's move to v4 did.
calls.undo: Point CARDS-ROUTINE.md's pin at version 5 for every essay.

left: Home can't get a page's pictures yet: testing's guard refuses pictures, so an essay with page scenes can't render on home until #3395 (a dispatch-only capture, a server pair and a retention family).
The essay is a silent draft. It waits on the owner's judgment, then a Kokoro render, then publishing to testing's cards/ with a fresh stamp (#3387, Where we are).
cards-check still passes a card whose own params the burn-ins refuse. It can't import them without a dependency cycle, so the render is the cards' check, and CARDS-ROUTINE.md now says so.
Optional review nit: CE1's cards-essay evidence line could name the new chapter-line refusal.
